hook.text: Palincsar and Brown's reciprocal teaching method improved reading comprehension scores by 50 % in struggling readers.

buildup.text: Reciprocal teaching has four roles: summarizer, questioner, clarifier, and predictor. Students rotate through all four.

discovery.text: Each role forces a different cognitive skill. Summarizing tests comprehension. Questioning tests depth.

twist.text: The clarifier role is the hardest. You must identify what was confusing and explain it clearly.

climax.text: After reading any text, practice all four roles yourself: summarize, question, clarify, and predict what comes next.

punchline.text: Four roles. One text. Complete comprehension.

quiz.question: Which role in reciprocal teaching builds metacognition most directly?
options: The summarizer, because it requires brevity
The clarifier, because it requires identifying confusion and explaining it
The predictor, because it requires guessing what comes next
